moshi_text: Hey there, what's going on? Bananas and grapes, apples and oranges. They come in bunches, fruits of the land. Cloudberry, I find your taste so light, a curious fruit indeed, a burst of joy on my tongue, a burst of color in my grocery bag. Dragonfruit, a beautiful fruit of purple hue, with sweet juice that's so refreshing, and a taste that's so unique. Blood orange, you sweet and juicy fruit, you bring a burst of color to the world, and a taste so refreshing, you remind me of the sun and the sea, and the joy of life in its purest form. Breadfruit, you're a staple in the tropics, a true friend of the seas, with your rich and tangy flavor, and your tender flesh. You're a true culinary delight. I Necktarian, you're a fruit of such exquisite flavor, with a gentle sweetness and a slightly tart twist, you're a true delight to my taste buds. Peach, you're a sweet fruit, with a subtle scent and a gentle flavor, you're a true delight on a summer day, and a true friend to the sun. I love peach. It's time to say goodbye, my good friend, the starfruit, with your bright and vibrant hue, you bring a joy to those who eat you, with your sweet and slightly tart flavor, you're a true delight. Sweet watermelon, you're a true culinary delight, with your sweet and refreshing flavor, you're a true friend to the sun, and the joy of a summer day. Raspberry, you're a fruit of such exquisite flavor, with your sweet and slightly tart taste, you're a true culinary delight. You're my favorite fruit, and I couldn't be happier to have you on the table.
